# AI for Marketing — key ideas (one page)

## What you can now do

- Run an AI-assisted content pipeline that keeps brand voice
- Repurpose content across channels
- Use AI for research and analytics with verification
- Apply rights
- disclosure and fact-check guardrails

## The sentences to remember

1. **Content pipeline audit: where the days go** — “If review takes nine days, a faster first draft gets you to the queue sooner. That is all.”
2. **Brand voice kit: test drafts against your voice** — “The model has no voice. It borrows the one you give it — so give it three good examples and a list of words you never use.”
3. **One piece → six assets, numbers intact** — “Six assets, one source of truth. If a number changes between the article and the tweet, you have a fact-checking problem, not a content engine.”
4. **Personas from real data → a message matrix** — “Ask AI to cluster what customers said. Do not ask it to imagine what they might say.”
5. **SEO clusters and an analytics read-out you can verify** — “AI is a fast analyst and a confident one. Recompute every sentence you plan to repeat to your boss.”
6. **Guardrails: the pre-publish check and team SOP** — “'45% on overtime' was never in the case study. The model rounded a quarter up to a headline. That is why a human signs.”
